Sensors Beacons Applications Room panels Floor plans Analytics Sensors True real-time occupancy Our world-class sensing technologies make Nimway possible. The solution's occupancy sensors can detect in true real time if a room or workspace is in use—letting employees quickly find free spaces and companies understand usage in fine detail. pause or play Beacons Find your position Nimway can pinpoint voluntary users’ mobile phones inside a building thanks to our positioning beacons. Users that opt-in benefit from locating colleagues and a wayfinding system for unfamiliar campuses. All user location data is secure and GDPR compliant. pause or play Applications Your virtual assistant The Nimway mobile app and web app are personal assistants at work. Book office access, parking, desks, and meeting rooms from anywhere, at any time. Search for workspaces with specific requirements, and use wayfinding to get there. Add key colleagues as "My Favorites", or report a problem in the facility. All this is possible, and more. pause or play Room panels Tap to book Nimway room panels display the availability of meeting rooms at the office. If the room isn't in use, the panel will appear green. If occupied, red. On the panel interface, employees can review the room's availability and easily book the times they need. pause or play Floor plans Orient and navigate Nimway digital floor plans are dynamic layouts that let any person at a workplace—whether regular employees or visitors—orient themselves with ease. See the real-time availability of all workspaces and locate employees that have opted to share their location. pause or play Analytics Insights about space usage Nimway aggregates your sensor data and room booking data to provide detailed, real-time space utilization insights with a high degree of granularity.
